title: Container Bookings: charging freight, surcharges, the loading guarantee premium and the manual booking fee
content:
## Policy clause
For the Container Bookings product line, freight is charged when the booking is confirmed and again for any containers added by amendment, one entry per charge code.
- **Ocean freight and terminal handling** are billed at the rate of the accepted spot quote or of the referenced contract's filed rate sheet. A quote or filed rate is bookable only within the tier's rate validity in calendar days of its issue; after that a new quote is needed.
- **Bunker**: when the tier's bunker billing basis is the contract BAF schedule, a separate bunker adjustment factor entry is charged from the contract schedule; when bunker is included in the quote, no separate bunker entry exists and none may be added.
- **Peak season surcharge**: the tier's per-container rate multiplied by the containers charged, when that rate is above 0.00.
- **Equipment imbalance surcharge**: the tier's per-container rate multiplied by the containers charged, when that rate is above 0.00.
- A tier whose surcharge rate is 0.00 is exempt, and no entry is written for it.
- **Loading guarantee premium**: the tier's per-container premium multiplied by the containers charged, when above 0.00.
- **Manual booking fee**: the tier's manual booking fee, charged once per booking, only when the booking's channel is the customer service desk and the fee is above 0.00.

Freight may be charged only while the booking's status, as recorded in the line's system, is confirmed, equipment released or gated in. Freight, surcharges, the premium and the manual fee are never waived as goodwill.

## Worked example (hypothetical rates)
*Hypothetical tier, for illustration only:* peak season surcharge 90.00, equipment imbalance surcharge 0.00, loading guarantee premium 60.00 and manual booking fee 20.00; a booking for 3 containers placed at the customer service desk is confirmed.
| Entry | Working | Amount (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Peak season surcharge | 90.00 multiplied by 3 containers | 270.00 |
| Equipment imbalance surcharge | rate is 0.00, tier exempt | no entry |
| Loading guarantee premium | 60.00 multiplied by 3 containers | 180.00 |
| Manual booking fee | desk channel, fee above 0.00, once per booking | 20.00 |

The same booking placed through the online portal would carry no manual booking fee entry.

## Points of judgement
**Can a bunker entry be added to a booking whose tier includes bunker in the quote?** No; none may be added.

**Can the peak season surcharge be charged on a cancelled booking?** No. Freight may be charged only while the booking is confirmed, equipment released or gated in.
